name: 015 Fundamentals of Math: The Big Picture
note: World units: frame height 8 = 1080 px (1 unit = 135 px). font_size (Manim) ≈ cap height in px at 1080p: 28 → 27 px, 48 → 46 px, 72 → 69 px (measured).

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Alias of bg (DS name).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The stage in every frame. Pure black; no gradient, texture, vignette or grain.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text, operators, digits and brackets in equations, results.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary labels, tick numbers, axis names, HUD labels, a parked tracker glyph.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: The solid fill of Hamilton's flat stone-grey card (ch3_s07); otherwise unused (map_off does its jobs). Never text; only C.text and C.muted sit on it.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Classic plane: unit grid lines (BASE).

tokens.name: grid_minor
tokens.usage: Classic plane: minor grid lines (BASE).

tokens.name: axis
tokens.usage: Classic plane: axes (BASE).

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The thin border of a framed panel (`panel`) and of the key-idea frame.

tokens.name: foundations
tokens.usage: Foundations pillar (Ch1): sets, logic, the glyph ∈, braces of set-builder notation, the inside-set tint at opacity-fill. Map node 0 (6 o'clock). DS hue-blue #5FB6FF, tuned by ΔE00 4.0.

tokens.name: quantity
tokens.usage: Quantity pillar (Ch2): π whenever π is the quantity (the locked estimate, the width tick π, the π of 2/π), 22/7, 355/113, the inscribed square and √2. Map node 1. DS hue-gold #FFD17E, tuned by ΔE00 4.0.

tokens.name: structure
tokens.usage: Structure pillar (Ch3): rotations e^{iθ}, their arcs, the group C6 (the map's own turns), quaternions. Map node 2. DS hue-violet #B58CFF, tuned by ΔE00 4.1.

tokens.name: space
tokens.usage: Space pillar (Ch4): χ = V − E + F, the torus wireframe, rubber-band shapes, the Tube map, the (θ, x) rectangle of Ch6. Map node 3 (12 o'clock). DS hue-teal #36D6B0, tuned by ΔE00 4.0.

tokens.name: change
tokens.usage: Change pillar (Ch5): d/dr, the rings and their unrolled strips, slopes, the sine arch of Ch6 and its area, e. Map node 4. DS hue-orange #FF9F3D, tuned by ΔE00 1.7.

tokens.name: uncertainty
tokens.usage: Uncertainty pillar (Ch6): P, the needles (crossing ones at full strength), the dots of the throws, running shares and estimates. Map node 5. DS hue-pink #FF6FA8, tuned by ΔE00 3.4.

tokens.name: circle
tokens.usage: THE recurring circle of every chapter: the needle-tip trace, x² + y² = 25, the unit circle, the two loops on the torus, the outer ring of the unrolled disk, the hub of the map. Warm white so it is never confused with plain text.

tokens.name: map_off
tokens.usage: Unlit map: the ring track, unlit node rings, unlit chords, unlit mini-map dots, empty tracker slots; the floorboard cracks under the needles. Graphics only, never text.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: The video's one contradiction (Ch2, ch2_s04): the clash 'p even, q even' struck through. Used once, never decoration. DS hue-red #FF5A4E.

tokens.name: math-hero
tokens.usage: The one hero equation of a beat: x² + y² = 25, dA/dr = 2πr, e^{iπ} + 1 = 0. One per frame.

tokens.name: math-working
tokens.usage: Working maths: equation stacks, the worked example of each chapter, counts.

tokens.name: math-label
tokens.usage: Point and tick labels inside a plot: (3, 4), 22/7, π/3. Never under 28.

tokens.name: glyph
tokens.usage: Map-node key glyphs: \in  \pi  e^{i\theta}  \chi  \tfrac{d}{dr}  P. Drawn in the pillar hue once lit; 36 in the tracker, 96 on a chapter card.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Key words and tags (inside, on, outside, rule), axis words, the takeaway words. Four words at most.

tokens.name: caps-name
tokens.usage: Lower thirds (G. Cantor · 1874) at 34, pillar names beside map nodes (32).

tokens.name: caps-card
tokens.usage: Chapter card title (the pillar name), the video title.

tokens.name: caps-eyebrow
tokens.usage: The key-idea eyebrow (28, C.muted); a small header over a card or panel.

tokens.name: readout
tokens.usage: Live counters and HUDs (throws, crossings, 2N / H). CM digits share one width (tabular), so counters never jitter; thousands split by a thin space (30 331).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Value to its unit, tick to its number.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Dot to its label, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Equation to its tag; line gap in an equation stack is space-6.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of the key-idea frame and the takeaway.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between lines of an equation stack; between panels of a split view.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a chapter-card title and its glyph.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: BASE edge margin: nothing drawn closer to the frame edge.

tokens.name: safe-margin
tokens.usage: Title-safe inset for text and HUD (DS safe-margin, 96 px). Lower thirds sit on it.

tokens.name: map-radius
tokens.usage: Map of Math: ring radius (node centres). Centre (0, 0).

tokens.name: node-radius
tokens.usage: Map node disk radius; the glyph sits inside at `glyph` size (≤ 1.5 × radius wide).

tokens.name: hub-radius
tokens.usage: The hub circle = THE circle: inscribed in the hexagram of skip-one chords (= map-radius / 2). The cold open's needle tips trace it.

tokens.name: minimap-radius
tokens.usage: Mini-map ring radius, top-right; lit dots 0.062, unlit 0.045, current ringed 0.125.

tokens.name: minimap-centre
tokens.usage: Mini-map centre (world units / px from top-left). Inside safe-margin on both edges.

tokens.name: tracker-slot
tokens.usage: e · i · π tracker slot radius (Ch3–Ch7); slots 0.66 apart from the top-left safe corner.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: Floorboard spacing = needle length (Buffon with l = d). Seed 1777, placement seed 1778.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Minor grid.

tokens.name: thin
tokens.usage: Ticks, unlit chords, panel frames, the map track.

tokens.name: chord
tokens.usage: Lit chords of the map (two-hue gradient).

tokens.name: node
tokens.usage: Lit map node rings (unlit rings 2.0, map_off).

tokens.name: curve
tokens.usage: Curves, arcs, square, rings, plotted estimates (BASE stroke).

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: THE circle, whenever it is the subject.

tokens.name: needle
tokens.usage: Needles drawn with skia (round caps); floorboard cracks 2 px in map_off.

tokens.name: opacity-fill
tokens.usage: Set tints: the inside of the circle (Ch1), overlapping disks, a lit node's disk; the plan's '15 percent' disk (ch4_s03). aion composites layers in linear light: 0.06 already reads as a clear tint. Over another shape of the same Manim layer Cairo blends in sRGB (about 11× darker), so a tinted disk that must hide what is under it uses the solid colour tint(hue, 0.06) at opacity 1 (style_frames.py).

tokens.name: opacity-region
tokens.usage: The one shaded region a beat is about: the area under the sine arch (Ch6; the plan's '30 percent').

tokens.name: opacity-ghost
tokens.usage: Ghost of a previous state, residue of a morph.

tokens.name: opacity-dim
tokens.usage: Old equation lines (dimmed, never deleted), dots outside a region, needles that miss; the plan's 'older lines dimming to 40 percent' (ch2_s04). In linear light 0.4 still reads bright; at 0.3 a line reads clearly dimmed and white text keeps 7:1.

tokens.name: opacity-floor
tokens.usage: The cold-open floor (cracks and resting needles) after 'no circle' (the plan's 'dims to 40%').

tokens.name: opacity-chord
tokens.usage: Lit chords of the map (a lit ring arc between neighbours: 0.9).

tokens.name: lead
tokens.usage: Motion lands on the beat and starts this early.

tokens.name: micro
tokens.usage: Fades, highlights, a tag in or out.

tokens.name: standard
tokens.usage: Moves, transforms, an equation term arriving, a dot sliding to its place.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: Signature moves: the needles sliding into the circle, the map turn, rings unrolling, a node opening.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Between members of a group: needles, rings, terms, nodes.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Hold after every signature shot before the next change.

tokens.name: map-turn
tokens.usage: The ring turns counter-clockwise by one sixth so the next pillar arrives at 6 o'clock.

tokens.name: push
tokens.usage: Camera push-ins on payoffs only; never more than 1.15×.

tokens.name: banned
tokens.usage: Never used for motion. Counters change value per frame (no tween).

map.note: Foundations at 6 o'clock, then clockwise. Each chapter turns the ring +60° (counter-clockwise) so the next pillar arrives at 6 o'clock.

pillar_separation.method: CIEDE2000; CVD by Machado et al. 2009, severity 1
